title: swida × horseyi
intro: Swida × horseyi, commonly known as the hybrid guelder-rose or hybrid marsh elder, is a cross between Swida sanguinea and Swida alba, native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Swida × horseyi include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and promote relaxation, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides.
